attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.file_id = f.file_id AND i.imported_file_id = 'src/click/_compat.py') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.file_id = f.file_id AND i.imported_file_id = 'src/click/utils.py') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.file_id = f.file_id AND i.imported_file_id = 'src/click/core.py') ORDER BY file_path
